(2) A close-up shot of a large white iMac retail box resting on a black equipment cart. (3) The scene shifts back to the woman in the kitchen, then cuts to a countertop filled with various groceries including milk, snacks, and frozen foods. (4) The woman uses her hands to open a box of mini pizzas, pulling out individual plastic-wrapped packs to show their size relative to her hands. (5) A medium shot from behind shows her opening a white Mitsubishi refrigerator and neatly organizing the milk and frozen items inside. (6) She holds up various products to the camera, including a large black bag of Karamucho chips, a clear container of Dorayaki pancakes, and several cartons of Kirkland brand milk. (7) She presents two large clear bottles of fruit juice followed by a white cardboard case of 'if' brand coconut water. (8) Using a utility knife, she carefully cuts open the coconut water box and removes a single carton to demonstrate how it can be flattened for recycling. (9) The woman returns to a medium shot, gesturing with her hands as she finishes her explanation in the same kitchen setting.
